name: Sterlite Technologies Ltd
title: Sterlite Technologies Ltd - 532374 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,441 crore (+37% YoY) and EBITDA margin 15.1%, but management gave no capacity or utilisation numbers and declined to comment on spot pricing or hyperscaler contracts.

utilisation.quote: broadly, it's improved slightly. As I said, we have called it out. We continue to have constraints with some of our raw materials.

capex.quote: we do expect that in near-term we will focus on our technology leadership and upgrading our asset base to support high-value data center portfolio offerings, which can have an approximate investment of INR 500 crores.

triggers.label: INR 500 crore upgrade capex for DC
triggers.quote: which can have an approximate investment of INR 500 crores

triggers.label: Refuses spot market sales
triggers.quote: We do not play in the spot market and we do not sell in the spot market.

triggers.label: Raw material availability constrains output
triggers.quote: the availability itself. And that is something that continues to be a challenge

triggers.label: Evasions on hyperscaler orders and capacity

guidance.metric: Enterprise and data centre share of revenue
guidance.quote: we expect the Enterprise and Data Center segment to scale up to 30% of revenues in the current fiscal
our structural margin profile continues to expand in line with our guidance of 20% at reported level by end of the current fiscal
with a revised ambition of moving below 1.2x

prior_guidance_check.metric: Enterprise and data centre share of revenue
prior_guidance_check.quote: enterprise and data centers moderated to 19% in FY26

red_flags.label: Raw material (germanium, helium) availability constraint
red_flags.quote: that is something that continues to be a challenge, but we do expect it to improve quarter-on-quarter

red_flags.label: Attach rate fell 22% to 15%
red_flags.quote: attach rates moderated to 15% from FY26 from 22% in FY25

red_flags.label: Prysmian litigation of around $100 million exposure
red_flags.quote: that's a huge liability of $100 million

red_flags.label: Refuses capacity and preform disclosure
red_flags.quote: we are not going to be disclosing capacities going forward

evasions.quote: I won't comment on any specific names or what our competition has done.
Sorry, Rahil, we do not disclose any of these things.
